POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)
November 6th 1916

Sir,
Director Li Tsoong Ngoh 李宗岳 of the Arsenal visited General Yang on 5th instant and afterwards instructed his subordinates to take stock of the arms and ammunition in the Arsenal. It is said that Director Li will soon be transferred to Tuchow in Shantung.
Loo Voong San 陆凤山 one of the rebel leaders alleged to have been robbed of the repatriation funds has established an office in Room 9 of the Zung Kaw Lu Kwan 众公旅馆 lodging house in roochow Road. It is said that the Commissioner of Foreign Affairs has promised to assist Loo and his followers.
Zee Nyeu Kau 徐文浩 Shanghai Taojin and Zee Kou Liang 席国良 Chief of Shanghai Woosung Police have left for Nanking to congratulate General Feng on his election to the Vice Presidency.
Liang Chi Tsao 梁启超 also left for Nanking at 11 p.m. 4th inst.
Distribution of money and passage tickets to destitute rebels took place at the house of General Li Tsung Woo at No.367/8 Avenue Edward VII on 4th and 5th instants and will be continued to-day. The money paid out has been provided by the Chamber of Commerce which appointed General Li to distribute it. Rebels receiving assistance in this way are divided into two classes viz "A" and "B" Those of "A" class receive $5.00 each without a passage ticket and those of "B" class receive $5.00 each and a passage ticket.
On 4th inst the claims of 394 Anwhui rebels were satisfied, the money and passage ticket being given to sixteen of their leders.
On 5th inst money and passage tickets were given to the representatives of 540 Anwhui and Chekiang rebels. These included members of both "A" and "B" classes.
Several of the rebels who were paid off

上海公共租界工部局。
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE JUNCTA）
警务处，
（侦探科）
1916年11月6日

先生：
兵工厂总监李宗岳于本月5日拜访杨将军，随后指示其下属清点兵工厂内的军火库存。据悉，李总监不久将调任山东德州。
据称被劫走遣返经费的叛乱首领之一陆凤山，已在福州路众公旅馆9号房间设立办事处。据说外交专员已承诺协助陆及其追随者。
上海道尹徐文浩及上海吴淞警察局长席国良已前往南京，祝贺冯将军当选副总统。
梁启超亦于本月4日晚11时启程前往南京。
向贫困叛乱分子分发钱款及船票的事宜，于本月4日及5日在爱德华七世大道367/8号李徵五将军寓所进行，并将持续至今日。所发放的钱款由商会提供，商会委任李将军负责分发。以此方式接受援助的叛乱分子分为两类，即“A”类和“B”类。“A”类每人获发5.00元，不含船票；“B”类每人获发5.00元及一张船票。
本月4日，394名安徽叛乱分子的诉求得到满足，钱款及船票已发给他们的16名首领。
本月5日，钱款及船票已发给540名安徽及浙江叛乱分子的代表。其中包括“A”类和“B”类成员。
部分已领取遣散费的叛乱分子

Shanghai Municipal Police.
Sinza Station.
November 6 th 1916
REPORT ON Repatriation Allowances & Steamer Tickets.
Made by Det.Insp.Fitzgibbon. Forwarded by Inspector Rivers.
Sir,
Between 2 & 4 P.M·on the 6 th inst
General Lee Tsun Woo 李徵五 at 367/8 Avenue Edward VII
besides distributing $3238.00. among 19 Anhwei & Chekiang
Revolutionary leaders who were instructed to pay their Officers
& men Five & Three Dollars Each, Repatriation Allowance, he also
divided among the Leaders in question a Steamer Ticket for Each
of 247 of their men who have already agreed to leave Shanghai.
Everything passed off quietly.
yours obediently,
Maurice Fitzgibbon.
Det. Insp.
Chief Detective Inspector.

上海公共租界警务处。
新闸捕房。
1916年11月6日
关于遣返津贴及轮船船票的报告。
由侦探督察 Fitzgibbon 撰写。经督察 Rivers 转呈。
先生：
本月6日下午2时至4时之间，
李徵五将军在爱德华七世大道367/8号，
除向19名安徽及浙江革命党首领分发3,238.00元（指令他们向其军官及士兵每人发放5元及3元不等的遣返津贴）外，
他还向上述首领分发了247名已同意离开上海的部下的轮船船票，每人一张。
一切进展顺利。
您顺从的仆人，
Maurice Fitzgibbon.
侦探督察。
首席侦探督察。

Form 2    34

Shanghai Municipal Police.

Sinza    Station.
November 5 th    191 6 .

REPORT ON    Repatriation Allowances.

Made by    Det.Insp.Fitzgibbon.    Forwarded by Inspector    .

Sir,

The information I received on
Saturday last regarding this matter was not quite correct.
I am told that the actual facts are that General Lee Tsun
Woo 李徵五 on 4 th instant at 367/8 Avenue Edward VII distributed
$2969.00. among 16 Anhwei Revolutionary Leaders who were
instructed to pay their officers & men, Five & Three Dollars
Each, Repatriation Allowance & a Passage Ticket for 120 of
their men who had promised to leave Shanghai. I am told that
110 of the party left the same night by two Steamers for their
Native places & the 10 others who sold their tickets in French
Concession are now locked up there.

Between 2 & 4 p.m.on 5 th inst $4146.00.was distributed at
the same address among 9 Anhwei & Chekiang Revolutionary
Generals who were instructed to pay their Officers & men Five
& Three Dollars Each,Repatriation Allowance.
As no Vessels were leaving to day,tickets were not issued.
Everything passed off quietly .

I am told that further sums will be distributed by General Lee
on 6 th instant.

yours obediently,
Maurice Fitzgibbon
Det.Insp.

Chief Detective Inspector.

上海公共租界警务处。

新闸    捕房。
1916年11月5日。

关于    遣返津贴的报告。

由    侦探督察 Fitzgibbon 撰写。    经督察    转呈。

先生：

我上周六收到的关于此事的情报并不完全准确。
据悉，实际情况是李徵五将军于本月4日在爱德华七世大道367/8号，
向16名安徽革命党首领分发了2,969.00元，
指令他们向其军官及士兵每人发放5元及3元不等的遣返津贴，
并为120名已承诺离开上海的部下提供船票。据悉，
该批人员中的110人于当晚乘坐两艘轮船返回原籍，
另外10人在法租界出售了船票，现已被关押在该处。

本月5日下午2时至4时之间，4,146.00元在
同一地址分发给了9名安徽及浙江革命党将军，
指令他们向其军官及士兵每人发放5元及3元不等的遣返津贴。
由于今日无船只离港，故未发放船票。
一切进展顺利。

据悉，李将军将于本月6日进一步分发款项。

您顺从的仆人，
Maurice Fitzgibbon
侦探督察。

首席侦探督察。

Form 2    34
Shanghai Municipal Police.
Sinza    Station.
November 4th    1916.
REPORT ON Repatriation allowances to Rebel leaders .
Made by Det.Insp.Fitzgibbon.    Forwarded by Inspector Kin..
Sir,
Between 12.30 & 3 p.m. on the 4 th
instant General Lee Tsung Wo at his residence, distributed
367/8 Avenue Edward VII, first distributed about $3000.00.
among Twenty Anhwei Revolutionary Leaders who were instructed
to pay their men, sums of Three & Five Dollars Each, repat-
riation allowance.
Everything passed off quietly.
Between the same hours on the 5 & 6th inst the Officers of
all Rebel soldiers belonging to the Chekiang Province will
receive Repatriation allowances for their men at this address.
yours obediently,
Maurice Fitzgibbon
Det.Insp.
Chief Detective Inspector.
（印：椭圆形印章）

新闸    捕房。
1916年11月4日。
关于向叛乱首领发放遣返津贴的报告。
由侦探督察 Fitzgibbon 撰写。经督察 Kin 转呈。
先生：
本月4日中午12时30分至下午3时之间，
李徵五将军在其寓所，
爱德华七世大道367/8号，首先向20名安徽革命党首领分发了约3,000.00元，
指令他们向其部下每人发放3元及5元不等的遣返津贴。
一切进展顺利。
本月5日及6日的同一时间段，
所有隶属浙江省的叛军军官将在该地址为其部下领取遣返津贴。
您顺从的仆人，
Maurice Fitzgibbon
侦探督察。
首席侦探督察。
（印：椭圆形印章）
